GetProjectBasic.ProjectRemark: Open area of the project is 2,283.61 sq. mtrs. The building plans of the project have been sanctioned under the Rajasthan Building Regulations, 2025 read with the Township Policy, 2024. The project comprises 143 flats and 22 stores situated in the upper basement, aggregating 165 saleable units. The said 22 stores shall be sold only to the allottees of the project and shall not be sold or transferred to any person who is not an allottee of a flat in the project. The common areas of the project comprise the lifts, staircases and corridors, the gymnasium and yoga room, the library and home theatre, the guard room, the parking areas, the common terrace, and the sewage treatment plant, underground water tanks, pump room and services / maintenance room.
